description: Iteration-1 FIND-007 ('STATUS is a winner-takes-all overwrite, HEAL-NEEDED silently drops a concurrent real EARNING signal') was NOT addressed in this iteration. Current loop.sh:83-89 is still a single if/elif/else chain with the exact same shape: `if [ -n "$HEAL" ]; then STATUS="HEAL-NEEDED — $HEAL"` unconditionally wins even when LM_MRR/CAP_REV were successfully computed as real positive dollar figures in the SAME wake (e.g. Stripe key is fine and LM_MRR=$500, but Capafy auth happens to be down this wake -> STATUS becomes only 'HEAL-NEEDED — CAPAFY-AUTH-DOWN...', the fact that $500 real LM MRR exists this wake is dropped from the narrative STATUS field, even though the raw `lm_mrr_usd:` line is still printed separately in STATE.md). The fix suggested in iteration 1 (compose both concerns, e.g. 'EARNING $500/mo + HEAL-NEEDED (Capafy down)') was not implemented; the code was rewritten for FIND-001/002/003 but this specific structural finding was left untouched.

evidence.snippet:
if [ -n "$HEAL" ]; then STATUS="HEAL-NEEDED — $HEAL"
elif [ "$LM_MRR" = "NA" ] || [ "$CAP_REV" = "NA" ]; then STATUS="READ-FAILED (LM_MRR=$LM_MRR Capafy=$CAP_REV) — a real total cannot be summed; DO NOT trust, recompute before acting"
else
  TOTAL="$(python3 -c "print(round(${LM_MRR}+${CAP_REV},2))" 2>/dev/null || echo NA)"
  if awk "BEGIN{exit !($TOTAL>0)}" 2>/dev/null; then STATUS="EARNING \$$TOTAL/mo ..."
  else STATUS="NO realised revenue yet ..."; fi
fi

fix: Compose STATUS so a real positive LM_MRR/CAP_REV figure computed this wake is never hidden behind a HEAL-NEEDED string for an unrelated surface, e.g. 'HEAL-NEEDED — CAPAFY-AUTH-DOWN(...) | meanwhile LM MRR=$500 (real, computed this wake)'.
